# APTREDLIGHT

> A Shenzhen-based OEM/ODM manufacturer of red light therapy panels, masks and flexible product platforms for private-label brands and professional sourcing teams.

Canonical website: https://www.aptredlight.com/
Brand: APTREDLIGHT
Company name presented by this website: Hongguang Bio-Phototherapy Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. / 弘光生物光疗科技（深圳）有限公司
Project markets discussed: United States, United Kingdom, Europe and Australia.

## Specification and document scope
Product-family images and names identify a sourcing direction. Confirm the exact SKU, configuration, operating mode and applicable measurement conditions.
Document availability, certification or registration scope, minimum quantity, sample schedule and fulfilment terms are confirmed for the particular project.
FDA establishment registration and device listing do not establish approval, clearance or authorization. ISO 13485 concerns a defined quality-management-system scope.
This is a concise website information index. It does not replace the linked pages or the website crawl/access policies.
